groups.title: Windows-1253 decoding of SoftOne responses via iconv-lite before JSON.parse
groups.normalizedClaim: SoftOne Web Services HTTP responses are consumed as binary (ArrayBuffer) and decoded from Windows-1253 (win1253/cp1253) to UTF-8 using iconv-lite before JSON.parse; res.text() alone is not considered safe.
groups.rationale: 4 distinct implementation repositories contain semantically equivalent observations. 1 supporting repository observation(s) have completed human review. Repository counts and review counts are computed from validated evidence members, not from model output.

members.claim: Observed implementation behavior: The integration decodes SoftOne Web Services responses via `response.arrayBuffer()`, `Buffer.from()`, and `iconv.decode(buffer, "win1253")` before `JSON.parse`, instead of using `res.text()`.

Observed implementation behavior: The fetch-companies route decodes the s1services response as ANSI 1253 (windows-1253) using iconv-lite and falls back to iso-8859-7, cp1253, and latin1 if JSON parsing fails.
Observed implementation behavior: Η υλοποίηση κάνει decode τις απαντήσεις του SoftOne από windows-1253 (ANSI 1253) σε UTF-8 χρησιμοποιώντας την βιβλιοθήκη 'iconv-lite' (win1253).
Observed implementation behavior: SoftOne Web Services responses are decoded from Windows‑1253 using iconv-lite, and the fetch response is consumed as an ArrayBuffer first.

groups.title: Authenticated clientID is persisted and reused across requests
groups.normalizedClaim: The authenticated SoftOne clientID is cached and reused for subsequent requests to avoid per-request authentication; the cache is stored in application-scoped state (HTTP cookie, local JSON file, database row, or in-memory module scope) and re-authentication only runs when the cache is missing or expired.
groups.rationale: 3 distinct implementation repositories contain semantically equivalent observations. No supporting repository observation has completed human review yet. Repository counts and review counts are computed from validated evidence members, not from model output.

members.claim: Observed implementation behavior: The implementation exposes an HTTP endpoint that initiates a SoftOne session by calling softOneLoginAndAuthenticate and persists the resulting clientID in a cookie named SOFTONE_CLIENT_ID_COOKIE.

This implementation caches the authenticated SoftOne clientID in a local JSON file at process.cwd()/.s1session.json with a 1-hour TTL and re-authenticates when the cached session is expired or missing.
This implementation uses per-day session persistence in a Prisma-managed database table to avoid repeated authentication.

groups.title: softOne TRDR table is the canonical trader identity source
groups.normalizedClaim: Customer/supplier records are read from the SoftOne 'trdr' table/object, with the TRDR field as the unique business identifier; the application upserts to its own store using TRDR as key and only falls back to a code+sodtype combination when TRDR is absent.
groups.rationale: 3 distinct implementation repositories contain semantically equivalent observations. No supporting repository observation has completed human review yet. Repository counts and review counts are computed from validated evidence members, not from model output.

members.claim: Observed implementation behavior: The implementation extracts specific fields from TRDR (CUSTOMER/SUPPLIER) browser rows: TRDR (business key), CODE, NAME, AFM, ADDRESS, CITY, ZIP, PHONE01, EMAIL, ISACTIVE.

Observed implementation behavior: The sync-companies route maps a SoftOne exported company record to a local Company model using fields sodtype (parsed to Int), trdr (parsed to Int), code, name, afm, country, address, zip, city, phone01, phone02, fax, jobtypetrd (parsed to Int), webpage, email, emailacc, irsdata, and a fixed concent=false default.

Observed implementation behavior: The implementation treats erpCompany.trdr as the unique SoftOne trader identifier and uses it as the primary lookup key for upserting companies (prisma.company.findUnique({ where: { trdr } })).

Observed implementation behavior: Κατά την ανάκτηση εταιρειών, η υλοποίηση παρατηρεί ότι τα δεδομένα εταιρειών επιστρέφονται σε JSON response με ιδιότητες όπως sodtype, trdr, code, name, afm, country, city, address, zip, phone01, jobtypetrd, webpage, email, emailacc, irsdata, upddate.
